Definition: from G1722 and G2928; to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with:--hid in.
BiblicalUsage: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal in Matthew 13:33, till the whole was leavened.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kingdom works like leaven — hidden, small, and quietly spreading until the whole lump is changed.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; Kingdom of heaven
